mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dd_requirement(requirement_id, case_id, program_requirement_id, status, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.requirementId}, #{row.caseId}, #{row.programRequirementId}, #{row.status}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT r.requirement_id AS requirementId, r.case_id AS caseId, r.status, r.version, p.requirement_code AS requirementCode, p.document_type AS documentType, p.required_flag AS requiredFlag FROM t_dd_requirement r JOIN t_dd_program_requirement p ON p.program_requirement_id = r.program_requirement_id WHERE r.case_id IN #{id} ORDER BY r.case_id, p.requirement_code
mapper.update: UPDATE t_dd_requirement SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE requirement_id = #{requirementId} AND version = #{version}
